correctness.rationale: For each existing thick generalized quadrangle order (s,t)>=2, point collinearity strongly regular parameters yield nontrivial incidence singular-value square s+t and possible incidence nullspaces. The point/line powered-distance block matrix splits the zero-sum hyperplane into one point-versus-line contrast, paired 2x2 singular sectors, and single-side null sectors. For p<=1 use b-1<=2(a-1) and a²>=4(a-1) to show paired determinant strictly positive and negative diagonals, while null sectors are negative below p0=log2(1+1/max(s,t)). Contrast is F(p)=A2^p+B4^p-C3^p-D divided by (s+1)(t+1)(st+1), with A,B,C,D as in RESULT. With u=2^p, 2B-C=2st(st-1)>0 and 0<gamma(gamma-1)<1 ensure the second derivative is positive; the first derivative at 1 is positive, f(1)=-(s+t+2), and explicit f(1+1/max(s,t))>0 give unique root alpha in (0,p0). This contrast is the first and only zero mode and becomes positive afterward, proving sharp CND, endpoint Hilbert rank N-2 and strict Gaussian kernels for every lambda>0 in valid interval. Independent 400-pair parameter root/block checks (s,t=2..21) and alpha(2,2)=0.34578472347643 corroborate but do not prove all existing GQs.
